summary: Verified VLibras accessibility widget (#vlibras-access-wrapper) visibility on /plataforma.html: hidden on mobile (390x800) both immediately after DOMContentLoaded and after reload (no flash), and visible on desktop (1920x800). Login form (CPF, Senha, Entrar) renders correctly on both viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Head-level CSS rule id='__hide_widgets_mobile_head' correctly prevents flash. Body-end rule id='__hide_widgets_mobile' is now redundant; consider removing to reduce duplication.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile (390x800): getComputedStyle(#vlibras-access-wrapper).display === 'none' immediately after DOMContentLoaded AND after reload (no flash). Desktop (1920x800): display === 'block'. Login form (CPF/Senha/Entrar) present on both. Bug fix confirmed.
rca of the issue: Previous placement of display:none rule at end of body allowed the fixed-positioned VLibras widget to render briefly on mobile before being hidden (flash). Moving the @media (max-width:979px){#vlibras-access-wrapper{display:none!important}} rule into <head> ensures it is applied during initial style computation, eliminating the flash. Verified: display is 'none' at DOMContentLoaded and after reload on 390px viewport, and 'block' on 1920px viewport.
